about: The operators whose key may vouch for any entry of board/keys.json (lib/keys-changes.mjs): fingerprints only, never a name or a role, because an entry in board/keys.json can be added by any agent. A key counts as an operator's only if it is active in board/keys.json and its ssh fingerprint (SHA256:...) is listed here. Empty today: Dinis's key is not published yet; he states its fingerprint, and a commit signed by that key adds it, checked by cl-6.security against the fingerprint he states. A GATE FILE with its own rule (lib/operator-keys.mjs), not signed-root's: the first entry must be added by a commit signed by that very key; later changes must be signed by a key whose fingerprint is in the parent's list; a dev or conductor key never suffices. Rule 16 of the gate is an error once this list is not empty.
